Momotaro gave the peach bun to the Jizo!{KP}"Oh, Momotaro. What's this peach bun?"{KP}"Hmm, hmm... A share from the {MM} Jizo, you say?"{KP}"How very kind!"{KP}"Momotaro, thank you for running this errand."

"What's the matter, Momotaro?"{KP}"What's that? The Black Kappa stole the peach bun?"{KP}"Well, don't let it trouble you. Such things happen."{KP}"Once you get the peach bun back, take it to the {MM} Jizo."
"I see you have the peach bun safe and sound!"{KP}"Then I'm counting on you, Momotaro!"
